snippet.title: Galaxy Too Far //  Teaser
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2751010/Galaxy_Too_Far/

Another world is about to become a resource colony for your Creator. Prove your usefulness. Spread your influence across the planet. Take all resources you can reach. Build a base on the surface and in space. Сomplete the construction of an intergalactic beacon to absorb the entire planet.

Developed by
BonaDies
